visualReview.notes: Every current standard frame inspected: pointed open gateway and vault ribs, royal facade niches, windows, stepped turret moldings, pierced gallery, four corner spires, chisel roof and gilded ridge remain coherent in close and distant views.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Every current shared frame inspected. Weathered sandstone walls and slate roof use reusable metric surfaces, while the kings and saints now have smooth carved-stone fallback surfaces. The portal remains genuinely open and the upper gallery and dormers are visible without missing or reversed faces.

geographicReview.notes: The mapped rectangular body, four corner turrets and eccentric stair projection agree with the orthographic overlay. The two portals retain their east/west alignment and the roof ridge is transverse to the gate. Native 65 m overall and 44 m gallery elevations remain unscaled.

fidelityReview.notes: Passed for the complete current detailed polygonal exterior. Published total/gallery/spire heights and the photographed nineteenth-century roof, royal niches, tracery and vault are represented. Figurative sculpture and heraldic carving remain original geometric interpretations at exterior viewing scale; the adjacent Municipal House is separate architecture.
